test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 3 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Jaya and Hema can clean an apartment in 30 days. Hema and Sushma can do the same task in 40 days, while Jaya and Sushma take 60 days to do it. How many days will it take all three of them working together to clean the apartment?
solution:
**Given:**

Jaya + Hema = 30 days

Hema + Sushma = 40 days

Jaya + Sushma = 60 days

**Formula used:**

Work rate (R) = 1 / Time (T)

Combined work rate = Sum of individual work rates

**Calculation:**

LCM of 30, 40, and 60 is 120.

⇒ Rate of Jaya and Hema = 120 /30 = 4

⇒ Rate of Hema and Sushma = 120/40 = 3

⇒ Rate of Jaya and Sushma = 120/60 = 2

⇒ Total = (4 + 3 + 2)/ 2 = 4.5

⇒ Total = 120/4.5

⇒ Total = 240/9 = 26(2)/(3) days

**Thus, all three working together can clean the apartment in 26(2)/(3) **** days.**
